note: City of Highland Haven, TX. INSTRUMENT: Code of Ordinances Ch. 9, Art. 9.02 § 9.02.003(f) Chart 1 (yards/height), Chart 2 (lot coverage) and Chart 3 (F.A.R.); current through Ord. No. 056 Rev. 18 (2026-07-07). SOURCE: ecode360.com, pack C (2026-10-07), cross-matched against the register (LDT #800). SCOPE: 4 of Highland Haven's 8 districts -- O, GB, LI, GUI (all District-C sub-categories). The other 4 stay UNROWED: R1 and R2 are SETBACK_CONDITIONAL_NOT_EVALUATED (lot configuration relative to Lake LBJ changes the stated yards); A and B are SETBACK_NO_DIMENSIONAL_STANDARDS (no yard/height/coverage numbers stated at all). READING RULES: O's Chart-2 cell spells out "50% main building(s); 60% main and all accessory", and GB/LI/GUI's cells use the SAME split abbreviated as a bare "X% / Y%" with no "accessory" wording restated -- GB/LI/GUI's numbers (60/70, 50/60, 60/70) match the Bertram-style main-vs-main-plus-accessory pattern (confirmed by O's own spelled-out figure matching Bertram's O entry number-for-number: "50% main; 60% main and all accessory"), so all four districts are coded the SAME way as Bertram's split: the lower, main-building-only figure into max_lot_coverage_pct, the higher main-plus-accessory total quoted as the condition, and max_impervious_pct not_specified (no distinct impervious standard is stated anywhere in this chapter). SENTINELS: not_specified = 100 (no row in this table needs the 999 height sentinel -- every served district states a height). No code-section atom corpus exists yet for highland_haven_tx; every value is primary-source-verified.
